title: Flink Fuchsia
description: The Apache Flink dashboard, reskinned and extensible: a Svelte UI with live job-graph load coloring, plus pluggable authorization, UI sections, and endpoints from drop-in JARs — no Flink fork or sidecar.

title: FLYT
description: Key contributor to FLYT (Flink over YTsaurus); built the FLYT Python launcher from scratch (CLI, profiles, SquashFS layers, jobshell, CI) and the data-metrics module for timestamp-based sink metrics.

title: Wili
description: Full-stack wishlist app with sharing, Telegram Mini App integration, and Yandex ID auth. SvelteKit + TypeScript frontend, Go microservices backend. Deployed to Yandex Cloud via GitHub Actions.

title: Modrinthium
description: A de-branded, telemetry-free fork of the Modrinth App: no analytics, ads, or account requirement, plus modpack installs and auto-updates straight from a hosted manifest URL.

title: PacketPray
description: Minecraft mod that mitigates crash scenarios related to network packets; 2.5M+ downloads on CurseForge.

title: ClinQ
description: LINQ-inspired validation library providing fluent method chains, mappings, dependency checks, and reusable validators.

title: Stoatium
description: A debranded, self-host-configurable build of the Stoat chat client — what VSCodium is to VS Code. Maintained as a patch series over pinned upstream tags instead of a vendored fork.

title: Droply
description: A minimalistic file transfer app using P2P and centralized flows. I focused on the backend (made a cross-fusion between Spring and Ktor frameworks for websockets).

title: TomShelBot
description: Telegram Java SDK wrapper: handlers, modularity (plugin jars), storage, commands, polls, and more.

title: TReports
description: A lightweight bug‑tracking tool used as a free alternative to collect tester feedback.

title: GenericTensor
description: Matrix/tensor calculus — implemented LU and PLU decompositions.

title: AngouriMath
description: Symbolic algebra library — I added a discrete math module and smaller improvements.

title: MxEngine
description: A-from-scratch 3D engine — fixed texture tooling bugs.
